summary: Transpose patch data coordinates in place while preserving source None return

identity.direction: Declared inputs to Mutated/copy patch list or None
identity.definition: Transpose patch data coordinates in place while preserving source None return
identity.model: Matplotlib affine transform composition using get_data_transform
identity.coordinates: Patch display/data coordinates, not physical vector coordinates
assumptions: Finite affine parameters and Matplotlib patch transform contract

outputs.name: patch_result
outputs.constraints: transpose returns None; scale mutates; mirror shallow-copies

preconditions: Finite affine parameters and Matplotlib patch transform contract
supported: Finite matplotlib Patch collections and affine transforms
excluded: No physical vector/coordinate field transformation claim
Artist ownership and arbitrary custom Patch subclasses are unqualified

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises TypeError, ValueError, or the underlying Matplotlib error for a non-iterable patch collection or invalid transform arguments.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Optional Matplotlib transform and patch-method failures propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; the transforms are direct affine operations.
failure_semantics.partial_results: A failed transform call does not promise a partially transformed collection; transpose_patches returns None after mutating supplied patches.

example.description: Apply the in-place R/Z transpose transform to one matplotlib rectangle.
example.code:
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
from scirel.geometry.plotting import transpose_patches

patch = Rectangle((0.3, 0.4), 0.2, 0.1)
assert transpose_patches([patch]) is None
example.expected: The patch is transformed in place and the historical API returns None.
